Grade: PP2
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION

Topic 3.1: Christian

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Christian. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.
